description: Goal: make quote reification preserve Elixir's raw two-tuple quoted representation so structural keyword tuples remain valid inside macro-generated source definitions. Signal: an ordinary legacy-surface item macro using quote to emit fn answer(), do: 42 must publish and execute answer/0; assert the quoted tuple contract in an adjacent *_test.rs path. Strategy: teach the one QuoteLowerer Expr::Tuple arm to emit a raw tuple when arity is exactly two, retaining {} AST calls for every other tuple arity. This removes no syntax and is a prerequisite for ticket fz-6lf.2's generated def proof. Fresh holistic review, full warnings-as-errors gate, one commit/close/draft stacked PR.
title: Preserve literal two-tuples while quoting generated source
